research_goal: Determine which future public interaction and propagation attributes are predictably identifiable from a time-bounded Community Archive network state, and quantify when topology, content, recurrence, and cross-population position add held-out information beyond boring priors.
privacy_boundary: Raw social records remain in the source repository; this ledger stores aggregate priors and public-safe hypothesis contracts.

benchmark_contract.split: rolling chronological origin with at least three held-out windows
benchmark_contract.label_window: declared per run and complete before scoring

hypotheses.claim: Pre-event content features predict whether a post receives a visible reply, quote, or mention better than the global positive-rate baseline.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: content_only average precision minus global_positive_rate average precision
hypotheses.prediction: positive mean delta across at least three held-out windows
hypotheses.falsifier: delta is non-positive in at least two windows or pooled confidence interval includes only non-positive values
hypotheses.prior_evidence: ROC AUC 0.554 and AP 0.106 at positive rate 0.086 in one held-out slice
hypotheses.v0_1_reason: content AP beat the global rate in all three windows, but the deterministic shuffled-time control matched or exceeded it in all three
hypotheses.v0_1_scope: reply_or_quote_targeting_authored_post; mentions excluded because target-post linkage is unavailable

hypotheses.claim: Recent relationship recurrence adds ranking information beyond content and historical account frequency for previously observed interactors.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: combined Recall@10 minus max(content_only, account_frequency, recurrence_only) Recall@10
hypotheses.prediction: positive mean delta across at least three held-out windows without reducing candidate coverage
hypotheses.falsifier: combined model fails to exceed the best boring baseline or improvement disappears under time-shuffle control
hypotheses.prior_evidence: three-day recency changed Recall@5 from 0.462 to 0.385 and Recall@10 from 0.462 to 0.462
hypotheses.v0_1_reason: seen-account support was below the frozen minimum of 30; descriptive account-frequency Recall@10 also exceeded combined ranking

hypotheses.claim: Post content and cross-population topic position predict whether the next visible interaction comes from an account unseen in training.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: combined average precision minus global new-account-rate baseline
hypotheses.prediction: positive mean delta across at least three held-out windows
hypotheses.falsifier: combined model does not beat the global-rate baseline or only account-activity volume explains the delta
hypotheses.prior_evidence: new accounts were 0.364 of held-out direct-interaction events

hypotheses.claim: Relationship partition and prior interaction type add information beyond content for distinguishing reply, quote, and mention events.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: combined macro average precision minus content_only macro average precision
hypotheses.prediction: positive delta with every class meeting the evaluability threshold
hypotheses.falsifier: class imbalance leaves any target unevaluable or combined performance does not beat content-only
hypotheses.prior_evidence: 129 identity-resolved relationship rows and 12 identity-resolved distribution rows exist

hypotheses.claim: A candidate account's cross-population position predicts whether its bridge post receives visible second-hop audience response.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: topology_plus_content average precision minus candidate_activity baseline
hypotheses.prediction: positive delta after at least 30 positive propagation events exist
hypotheses.falsifier: no positive events accrue, or candidate activity/follower count explains all observed performance
hypotheses.prior_evidence: 36 bridge posts, zero observed audience-response positives, zero two-hop edges

hypotheses.claim: Repeated visible interaction predicts a later transition from one-sided follow relation to mutual relation.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: interaction-history model average precision minus partition transition-rate baseline
hypotheses.prediction: positive delta across synchronized relationship snapshots
hypotheses.falsifier: no synchronized later snapshot exists, or interaction history does not beat the partition baseline
hypotheses.prior_evidence: one relationship snapshot exists; no lifecycle labels

hypotheses.claim: Posts with identical declared observation profiles but different outcomes create a measurable ceiling on exact archive-event prediction.
hypotheses.primary_comparison: empirical best class-constant accuracy versus observed model accuracy
hypotheses.prediction: model performance remains at or below the class-conditional ceiling on every held-out window
hypotheses.falsifier: a leakage-free model exceeds the computed ceiling, implying the observation partition or ceiling implementation is wrong
hypotheses.prior_evidence: finite observation-class theorem implemented only on synthetic worlds

hypotheses.claim: Propagation-weighted network position predicts later claim accuracy after controlling for claim topic and source evidence.
hypotheses.prediction: left unspecified until an outcome rubric and independent labels are frozen
hypotheses.falsifier: outcome labels remain unscored or network position adds no held-out information
hypotheses.prior_evidence: claim ledger exists but every outcome is unscored
